maculaStatus: Macular reflex present; microaneurysms near temporal margin require OCT follow-up for edema evaluation.

recommendation: Ophthalmology follow-up recommended within 2 to 3 months.
analysisSummary: AI evaluation reveals moderate non-proliferative diabetic retinopathy (NPDR) with focal vascular tortuosity and microvascular abnormalities along the inferior arcade.
